minor.issue: Response carries 'access-control-allow-origin: *' together with 'access-control-allow-credentials: true' (header appears to be injected by the preview ingress, not FastAPI). Harmless in preview but verify explicit-origin CORS in production.

issues: Search only fires on Enter (no debounce, no hint). Typing without Enter leaves the list unfiltered — add debounce or an 'Enter zum Suchen' hint.

action_items: Optional: debounce the admin handoff search input (currently Enter-only).

Note: /admin/dashboard is not a defined route — it redirects to '/', where the assistant launcher correctly appears. FRONTEND-FIX-2 verified on real admin routes (/admin, /admin/assistant-handoffs) where the launcher count is 0.
critical_code_review_comments: Rate limit is in-memory per process only; with multiple backend workers/pods the 5/h/IP budget multiplies. Consider a shared store if abuse protection matters.
_real_ip trusts the leftmost X-Forwarded-For value, which a client can spoof to bypass the handoff rate limit. Behind a trusted ingress prefer the rightmost/trusted-hop IP.
Home page fires ~17 x 401 responses for unauthenticated session probes in the console — noisy, consider gating auth/me-style calls.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of retested flows (4/4 fixes verified + regression)

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_assistant_handoff.py must be run with -n 0 (in-memory 5/h/IP rate limit; each class restarts backend). Handoff POSTs from the Playwright container share the rate-limit bucket with pytest runs — restart backend before UI handoff tests or you get a legitimate 429. Visitor gate must be dismissed via localStorage keys kapitalmitte_visitor_profile + kapitalmitte_cookie_consent BEFORE navigating to /login, otherwise the gate dialog (z-[10000]) intercepts the login button.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous 2 pytest failures were fixed in app code (consent 'is not True' check; ordered _strip_pii with PIN_DIGITS regex and (?<!\[) lookbehind in SENSITIVE). The only test-side change needed was updating the outdated assertion expecting the old '[IBAN entfernt]' marker to the new spec marker '[Kontoverbindung entfernt]'. A 429 seen in the first UI run was self-inflicted (shared rate-limit bucket with the pytest suite), not an app defect — confirmed by re-running after a backend restart.
